title: Your data (GDPR)
intro: You can download a copy of your data or delete your account. Both require a fresh code from your authenticator app.
stepUpInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired. Enter a new code.
exportBody: A ZIP archive with a JSON file and CSV files. It stays available for 24 hours and can be downloaded once.
exportReady: The export can be downloaded until {expiresAt}.
exportFailed: The export could not be prepared. Try again later.
exportExpired: The export has expired or was already downloaded.
exportConflict: The previous export is still being prepared.
exportLimit: The daily export limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
deleteBody: Your account and all related data will be permanently deleted after 14 days. Until then you can cancel the request. Audit entries are kept only under a pseudonym.
deleteConfirm: I understand the account cannot be recovered after 14 days.
deleteScheduled: The account will be deleted on {date}.
deleteCancelled: The account deletion request was cancelled.
readme:
OligInvest data export (GDPR, Articles 15 and 20)

Archive contents:
- data.json: every dataset in one JSON file (format oliginvest-gdpr-export, version 1).
- csv/: one CSV file per dataset (UTF-8 with BOM, comma separator, CRLF line endings). Cells starting with =, +, -, @ are prefixed with an apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run them as formulas.
- files/: files you uploaded, for example original import files.

Amounts and quantities are decimal text without rounding; the currency is in its own column. Times are UTC (ISO 8601).
The export contains no secrets (password hashes, TOTP keys, session tokens, API key hashes) and no data of other users.
The archive is available for 24 hours after it is prepared and can be downloaded once.
